title: Words with crossed-out letters are uncontracted, then repeated with a hyphen substituted for each crossed-out letter. The repeated word is enclosed within transcriber’s note indicators.

illustrates.quote: Words with crossed-out letters are uncontracted, then repeated with a hyphen substituted for each crossed-out letter. The repeated word is enclosed within transcriber’s note indicators.

resolution: Both runs (A, B) came from the same model (Gemini Pro via Antigravity, 17 Sep 2026) and are not independent; agreement was treated as no evidence. braille.lines independently re-extracted from references/_text/braille-formats-2016.txt (the line-number field, digits + >=3 spaces, or the fixed left margin measured in ASCII spaces before any U+2800 cell, stripped by counting; U+2800->space; trailing spaces removed). Both runs agree: no braille anywhere near this citing location (braille.lines: []) — the suggested wording embedded inline in rule 17.11.2c's own running text (source lines 13715-13718). illustrates.rule already carries the correct rule id in both runs ('17.11.2c'), not a placeholder.
